title: The failed access address and the failed instruction address are two fields
summary: For synchronous faults that provide si_addr, it identifies the fault address. The program counter identifies the instruction being executed.
applies: Native program crash reporting and DWARF debugging metadata
detail: For example, when analyzing data access failures, the access address in the report can be far different from the code address, and the memory mapping and symbols should be corresponding to the field semantics.
boundary: Not all signals and sources provide meaningful si_addr. Both signal type and si_code should be checked.
relevance: When interpreting an existing crash dump, locate the source code location and the location of the accessed data separately.
